# Third-party source

The converter project expects AssetStudio source at:

```text
third_party/AssetStudio
```

Prepare it with:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Perfare/AssetStudio.git third_party/AssetStudio
```

`third_party/AssetStudio` is intentionally ignored by Git to avoid copying upstream source into this repository without preserving its own history.
